newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks fall 2.08 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks fall 2.08 pct in late trade.

text.p: Taiwan share prices plunged 2.08 percent in late Friday trade as disappointed investors dumped shares which showed worse-than-expected first quarter performance, brokers said.
With 45 minutes left of trade, at 0315 GMT, the index had lost 176.38 points or 2.08 percent to 8,309.28. Turnover was T$81.3 billion.

Despite a newspaper report that all 386 listed firms' net profit in the first quarter surged a year-on-year 43 percent to T$70.62 billion, brokers said the share prices of many firms were over-valued.
"Many investors are disappointed after realising their companies' share prices did not match the performances," said Albert Lin, an analyst of Golden Securities.
Selling was heavy in electronics, paper and construction shares.
Chipmaker United Micro lost T$2 or 3.0 percent to T$65. -- Alice Hung (2-5080815)
